data.name: Ketul
data.gender_notes: Ketul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ketul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ketu', which represents the Moon's tail in Hindu astrology. The name carries a spiritual significance, symbolizing protection, guidance, and the influence of the moon on one's life. The name Ketul carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ketul usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Raj' also carries deep spiritual significance.
